description: Internal Drainage Districts (IDD) is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Wales. Drainage districts are typically found in low-Iying land where boundaries are determined by physical, not, political attributes. Districts vary in nature and size, from the mainly agricultural (such as Conwy, Llanfrothen and Towyn) to the semi-urban (such as the Gwent Levels). Drainage districts are at risk from various sources of flooding. Coverage: Natural Resources Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Wales. Its tags are drainage, flood defence. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
